name: The Bugle Hut
reason: Private 100-year-old hut offered as an event venue (SATC listing says 'the building is yours to create your perfect event'); no public visit.

name: Lock 1 Blanchetown
reason: For: first of the Murray's 13 locks (1922), still busy, listed on SATC Riverland attractions and overlooked by Hunter Road Lookout. Against: SATC listing is a bare name, the product page 404s, and a lock is a short look.

name: Renmark Rotary Lookout Tower
reason: Wikivoyage See entry (24/7, 360-degree views over farmland and town) plus Discover Renmark; free open lookout.

name: Paringa Bridge
reason: For: Wikivoyage See entry, 1927 heritage bridge with a shared walk/cycle path over the Murray. Against: single source, a walk across is short and Wikivoyage itself calls the path infrastructure questionable.

name: Kuerschner Boardwalk
reason: Wikivoyage (Nov 2025) says it is temporarily closed and flood-prone; small boardwalk.

name: Ral Ral Loop
reason: For: Wikivoyage Do entry, 2-day paddle loop from Murtho Forest Landing through Murray River National Park creeks. Against: no agency page names it as 'Ral Ral Loop' (PaddleSA calls it the Nelbuck Island Loop), needs a canoe and camping; searched parks.sa.gov.au and PaddleSA.

name: PS Industry
reason: Historic 1911 paddle steamer moored on Renmark's riverfront, a floating museum open to walk aboard in visitor centre hours; SATC attraction page and Discover Renmark. The place is the moored museum ship (cruises are extra).

name: Berri Lookout Tower
reason: For: SATC attraction page, converted water tower with 15.8 m climb and views of Berri and the river, open daily, free. Against: single source and a 15-minute stop.

name: Berri Bridge Mural
reason: Minor public art under Berri Bridge (SATC page): a mural and totem poles, a short look; part of the Berri riverfront walk rather than a half-hour draw.

name: Sturt's Memorial Berri
reason: Minor memorial (1930 inscribed marker for Sturt's 1830 voyage); no visit beyond a glance.

name: Alan Glassey Park
reason: Regional sports park (hockey, baseball, bowls, netball) per the SATC page; not a visitor attraction.

name: Banrock Station Wine and Wetland Centre
reason: Wikivoyage Barmera See entry and SATC attraction page: three self-guided trails through restored wetlands with boardwalk and bird hides (up to a 9 km loop). The wetlands are the draw, not the cellar door.

name: Loveday Internment Collection
reason: For: SATC Barmera page names it; WWII camp for up to 5,380 internees, display plus arranged tours of camp ruins. Against: it is a display inside the Barmera Visitor Information Centre, so a short visit and arguably part of the centre.

name: Loveday Adventure Park
reason: Private 8,000-acre 4x4 camping park with a tavern (SATC page): an operator/campground, not a sightseeing place.

name: Barmera Theatre Gallery
reason: Small volunteer-run gallery and craft shop in the Bonney Theatre complex (SATC), open a few hours on a few days; shop/local gallery.

name: Celebration of Life Statue (Barmera)
reason: Minor statue; SATC listing is a bare name, product page 404s and searching found no description of it. Minor memorial/sculpture.

name: Hawdon and Bonney Obelisk
reason: Minor memorial: 1938 centenary obelisk with plaques on the lake shore; a glance.

name: Waikerie Rotary Cliff Top Walk and Art Trail
reason: 2 km clifftop walk from the ferry to lookouts over the Murray floodplain, with murals and sculptures, linking to the silos; SATC attraction listing, free.

name: Waikerie Silo Art
reason: Double silo mural (two artists, painted on both sides, almost 30 m tall) on the clifftop in Waikerie; SATC attraction page and the Australian Silo Art Trail. A named roadside icon.

name: Waikerie Street Art Tour
reason: A Storytowns tour (operator) of the same street art and silo art; duplicate of Waikerie Silo Art / Cliff Top Walk and Art Trail.

name: Loxton Mini Silo Art Trail
reason: Seven painted concrete pipe sections inside Loxton Community Conservation and Heritage Park; duplicate of Loxton Tree Sculptures (same park and walk), kept as the one spot.

name: Loxton Tree Sculptures
reason: 16 chainsaw-carved tree sculptures along an easy walking trail in Loxton's conservation and heritage park (SATC attraction page, free); the park's mini silo art sits on the same walk.

name: Murray River Queen (Loxton)
reason: Moored paddle vessel run as hotel rooms with an on-board cafe; accommodation/business, no museum found.

name: Riverland Wine Centre
reason: Wine centre/cellar door and shop, one of many; not singled out as a destination in its own right (SATC listing only; product page 404s).

name: Illalangi Gourmet Foods
reason: Food producer/providore: a shop, not a place to see.

name: Wilkadene Woolshed Brewery
reason: Brewery in a woolshed (Wikivoyage Drink-style entry): one of many cellar-door-type venues, not singled out as a destination in its own right.

name: Havenhand Chocolates
reason: Chocolate shop and cafe; a business, not a place to see.

name: Rivergum Cruises
reason: Operator of river cruises; a cruise is not a spot.

name: MV Fay Murray River Cruises
reason: Operator of river cruises; a cruise is not a spot.

name: Renmark River Cruises
reason: Operator of river cruises; a cruise is not a spot.

name: Canoe Adventures Riverland
reason: Operator: kayak tours and hire.

name: Big Heart Adventures
reason: Operator of adventures/tours.

name: Mick's Creek Tours
reason: Tour operator.

name: Murray River Trails (Renmark)
reason: Operator of guided tours.

name: Murray River Tinny Tours and Boat Hire
reason: Operator: boat hire and tours.

name: Pike River Woolshed
reason: Heritage woolshed run as accommodation (SATC lists it with bar/BBQ facilities); no public visit as an attraction.

name: Revolution Motor Museum
reason: Private muscle-car collection at Mypolonga; the Murray River tourism page says entry is by appointment only, not open to the public.

name: River Rides Motorcycle Museum
reason: Tourism board's 777 Motor Museum Trail calls it an extensive collection of historic motorbikes and memorabilia; about 52 bikes on display, open most days 9am-4pm in Mannum. A small museum a guide names.

name: Mid Murray Class Car Gallery
reason: Tourism board's trail page: Mid Murray Classic Car Gallery at Swan Reach, 16+ classic vehicles, $2 entry; a small museum. If it is the same venue as Swan Reach and District Museum, merge into one spot.

name: Camp Coorong
reason: For: the Murray River tourism history page names Camp Coorong for immersive Ngarrindjeri cultural experiences, and it has a museum (baskets, boomerangs, photos). Against: it is run as a group cultural-education camp, and Wikipedia says it was officially closed to the public in 2018; current public access unconfirmed.

name: Meningie Lions Park and Information Hub
reason: Visitor information hub beside a small town park; a visitor centre/ordinary park, not a distinct draw (the nearby Meningie Cheese Factory Museum is separate).

name: Dairy Adventures Farm Experience
reason: Operator: farm/dairy experience; a business rather than a place.
